items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You’re doing Sunny, Bobby Hebb’s big hit.

ctx.x: It sounds like you were taking this concept of trying to put something on the recording that people would like, because when we look at some of the titles on that – you got a lot of r- – you got some r-and-b. You got some pop hits on there. But you’ve been singing all along. So we want to make sure that folks listening to this know that you have been singing all along, with the encouragement of Columbia. But then now, when you get to Verve, you got female vocalist backgrounds. You’re doing Sunny, Bobby Hebb’s big…
